# 词典 W

## 概述

本页收录以字母 W 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设易混淆辨析与常用短语与搭配，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇         | 词性    | 含义               | 常见搭配                                       | 例句                                                    |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| wholesale    | n./adj. | 批发；批发的       | wholesale price, wholesale market              | We buy office supplies at wholesale prices.             |
| workforce    | n.      | 劳动力，员工队伍   | skilled workforce, remote workforce            | The company is investing in its workforce.              |
| workflow     | n.      | 工作流程           | approval workflow, workflow automation         | The new workflow reduced processing time by 40%.        |
| warranty     | n.      | 保修，质保         | warranty period, under warranty                | The laptop is still under warranty.                     |
| waive        | v.      | 放弃（权利），免除 | waive the fee, waive a requirement             | The bank agreed to waive the late payment fee.          |
| withdraw     | v.      | 撤回，提取         | withdraw a proposal, withdraw funds            | She decided to withdraw her application.                |
| worthwhile   | adj.    | 值得的             | worthwhile investment, worthwhile effort       | The training program is a worthwhile investment.        |
| workload     | n.      | 工作量             | heavy workload, manage workload                | The team's workload has doubled since the merger.       |
| wrap up      | phr.v.  | 完成，结束         | wrap up a meeting, wrap up a project           | Let's wrap up this discussion and move to action items. |
| win-win      | adj.    | 双赢的             | win-win situation, win-win solution            | We found a win-win solution that benefits both parties. |
| well-rounded | adj.    | 全面的             | well-rounded candidate, well-rounded education | We're looking for a well-rounded candidate.             |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇           | 词性 | 含义           | 常见搭配                                     | 例句                                                    |
| -------------- | ---- | -------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| widespread     | adj. | 广泛的，普遍的 | widespread use, widespread concern           | There is widespread concern about data privacy.         |
| willing        | adj. | 愿意的         | willing to help, willing participant         | She's always willing to lend a hand.                    |
| wisdom         | n.   | 智慧           | conventional wisdom, words of wisdom         | His grandmother shared her wisdom about life.           |
| wander         | v.   | 漫步，闲逛     | wander around, wander the streets            | We wandered around the old town for hours.              |
| wholesome      | adj. | 健康的，有益的 | wholesome food, wholesome entertainment      | They prefer wholesome family activities on weekends.    |
| witty          | adj. | 机智的，风趣的 | witty remark, witty humor                    | His witty comments always brighten the mood.            |
| worn out       | adj. | 疲惫的；磨损的 | worn out shoes, feel worn out                | I felt completely worn out after the long hike.         |
| worthless      | adj. | 无价值的       | worthless junk, feel worthless               | Don't keep worthless items that clutter your space.     |
| wholeheartedly | adv. | 全心全意地     | wholeheartedly support, wholeheartedly agree | I wholeheartedly support your decision to study abroad. |
| wary           | adj. | 谨慎的，警惕的 | wary of strangers, wary of scams             | Be wary of emails asking for personal information.      |
| whereabouts    | n.   | 下落，行踪     | unknown whereabouts, current whereabouts     | No one knows the whereabouts of the missing hiker.      |

## 技术相关

| 词汇      | 词性  | 含义               | 常见搭配                               | 例句                                                                     |
| --------- | ----- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| widget    | n.    | 小部件，组件       | UI widget, dashboard widget            | Add a weather widget to the home screen.                                 |
| webhook   | n.    | 网络钩子           | webhook URL, configure a webhook       | Set up a webhook to receive real-time notifications.                     |
| wrapper   | n.    | 包装器，封装层     | API wrapper, wrapper function          | We wrote a wrapper around the third-party API.                           |
| whitelist | n./v. | 白名单；加入白名单 | whitelist an IP, whitelist a domain    | Please whitelist our server IP in the firewall.                          |
| wildcard  | n.    | 通配符             | wildcard character, wildcard match     | Use a wildcard to match any file extension.                              |
| workspace | n.    | 工作区             | shared workspace, workspace settings   | Each developer has their own workspace configuration.                    |
| WebSocket | n.    | WebSocket 协议     | WebSocket connection, WebSocket server | WebSocket enables full-duplex communication between client and server.   |
| worker    | n.    | 工作线程，Worker   | web worker, service worker             | Use a service worker to enable offline caching.                          |
| WASM      | n.    | WebAssembly        | WASM module, compile to WASM           | WebAssembly allows running C++ code in the browser at near-native speed. |
| WAF       | n.    | Web 应用防火墙     | WAF rules, deploy WAF                  | Deploy a WAF to protect against common web attacks.                      |

## 易混淆辨析

| 词组                     | 区别说明                                                            |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| withdraw vs. retreat     | withdraw 偏正式（撤回申请、提取资金），retreat 偏指物理或军事撤退   |
| worthwhile vs. worthy    | worthwhile 指值得花时间精力，worthy 指值得尊敬或配得上              |
| widespread vs. universal | widespread 指分布广泛但不一定全覆盖，universal 指全面的、普遍适用的 |
| workflow vs. process     | workflow 侧重步骤和流转顺序，process 更泛指任何过程                 |
| wary vs. cautious        | wary 含有不信任的警觉感，cautious 只表示小心谨慎                    |
| witty vs. humorous       | witty 强调机智巧妙，humorous 更广泛地指幽默有趣                     |

## 常用短语与搭配

| 短语           | 含义           | 例句                                                       |
| -------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| work around    | 变通方法       | We found a workaround for the browser compatibility issue. |
| weigh in       | 发表意见       | The CTO weighed in on the architecture decision.           |
| win over       | 说服，争取支持 | She won over the skeptics with her demo.                   |
| wipe out       | 消除，毁灭     | The bug wipe out all unsaved data.                         |
| wind down      | 逐渐结束       | The project is winding down after two years.               |
| word of mouth  | 口碑传播       | The app grew entirely through word of mouth.               |
| with regard to | 关于           | With regard to your request, we'll follow up next week.    |
| way ahead of   | 远远领先于     | Their AI research is way ahead of the competition.         |
| work out       | 解决；健身     | We'll work out the details in the next meeting.            |
| write off      | 注销；一笔勾销 | The company had to write off the failed investment.        |
| well-versed    | 精通的         | She's well-versed in cloud architecture.                   |
| word for word  | 逐字逐句地     | He repeated the instructions word for word.                |
| wear many hats | 身兼数职       | In a startup, everyone wears many hats.                    |
| walk through   | 详细讲解       | Let me walk you through the deployment process.            |
| what it takes  | 所需条件       | She has what it takes to be a great leader.                |
| well-informed  | 消息灵通的     | Stay well-informed about industry trends.                  |
